title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Court Public Officials) <No. 2507, December 10, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on December 12, 2013. <Proviso omitted>
Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.
Article 8 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) Part of the Rules on Handling Affairs of Divisions of High Courts at Locations of District Courts shall be amended as follows:
In Article 6 (2), "general-service and technical-service public officials" shall be replaced with "general-service public officials."
(2) through (8) Omitted.
